import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();
        ArrayList<Character> result = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean flag_at = true;
        int len = s.length();

        for (int index = 0; index < len; index++) {
            char ch = s.charAt(index);
            if (index >= 2 && index < len && s.substring(index - 2, index + 1).equals("dot")) {
                // Remove last two characters if they exist
                if (result.size() >= 2) {
                    result.remove(result.size() - 1);
                    result.remove(result.size() - 1);
                }
                result.add('.');
            } else if (index >= 1 && index < len && s.substring(index - 1, index + 1).equals("at") && flag_at && index != len - 1) {
                if (!result.isEmpty()) {
                    result.remove(result.size() - 1);
                }
                result.add('@');
                flag_at = false;
            } else {
                result.add(ch);
            }
        }

        StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
        for (char c : result) {
            output.append(c);
        }
        System.out.println(output.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
